# Handoff log

Append-only. Newest at the bottom. One line per event:

`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM · <Claude|Codex> · STARTED | DONE | PAUSED · Stage N <name> · <episode> · <files> · <notes>`

Example:

`2026-10-20 19:33 · Claude · DONE · Stage 8 Output1 · wib-001 · Output1 - without effects/WIB-Ep01-Output1.mp4 · 32:31, 4K HEVC, -14.6 LUFS, decode scan clean`
